method: Version 37. Expected 5-2 score averages every observed realized board from 200 simulated games. Full boards use 16 fresh paired seeds; realized boards use three. Fights play both sides against the same 18 ranked comps: 80% stage four, 20% stage three, weighted by the square root of games. Seals off, neutral starting weather. Seven items: three tank, three carry, one secondary. Bad game is the 20th percentile. Optional caps do not set tiers.
